description.value: Float30 is a seafood and fish-and-chips restaurant situated at Reed Point Marina in Port Moody, offering panoramic waterfront views. The kitchen serves fresh daily seafood alongside a full scratch breakfast menu, making it a substantial meal stop on the Inlet waterfront route. A covered, heated patio lets cyclists eat outside in variable west-coast weather.

address.value: Reed Point Way, Port Moody, BC V3H 3R5
